title: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 1.1 Basic Set Concepts: Represent sets in a variety of ways.
summary: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 1.1 Basic Set Concepts: Represent sets in a variety of ways.
body: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, section "1.1 Basic Set Concepts", prints these objectives: "Represent sets in a variety of ways." "Represent well-defined sets and the empty set with proper set notation." "Compute the cardinal value of a set." "Differentiate between finite and infinite sets." "Differentiate between equal and equivalent sets.". This card reports that page.
